canDo: Can compare two or more options with comparatives and superlatives, explaining choices and trade-offs.
input: Listening: consumer choices; reading: two options compared.
output: Write a 120-word comparison; speak for 2 minutes on “A or B?”.
checkpoint: Compare on at least 3 criteria and reach a conclusion; use plus/moins/aussi/autant and common superlatif forms correctly.
challenge: Today’s challenge: compare two means of transport or two housing options in your city in 6 sentences, using plus…que, moins…que, aussi…que and le plus at least once each; end with one sentence giving your choice and your reason, and talk about it for 2 minutes.

questions.why: The flight is shorter, but getting to and from the airport and security add about two hours. The text doesn’t say the train is never late.
« le prix bouge peu selon la date » — that is exactly what sets it apart from the other two.
« aussi souple que l'avion sur le prix, mais nettement plus régulier sur la durée ». aussi … que means equal.
The costs the text lists as specific to owners are the taxe foncière, major repairs and service charges that can’t be passed on.
One to two years’ rent is the scale of the owner’s extra costs over twenty years, not the notary’s fees.
« plus votre horizon est incertain, moins l'achat est intéressant » — the double comparison plus…moins.
« moins de deux euros de différence » — differences in speed hardly affect annual energy use.
« le seul à obtenir une bonne note sur les quatre critères à la fois »; the fastest is D, and the text doesn’t say B is the cheapest.
« elle dépend surtout du logement ». Rural areas are where the gap widens, not the main factor.
The lowest-earning 20% spend almost twice the share on housing and energy that the highest-earning 20% do.
« il est mieux isolé : les charges sont deux fois moins élevées ». The second flat is smaller and on the first floor.
« C'est là que l'écart est le plus net » comes straight after the travel distance (ten minutes versus three).
The low first-year price is real, but it doubles after twelve months: you only save if you switch again in time.
Poor coverage → using mobile data at home too → more expensive in practice.
20 minutes by car + 10–15 minutes to find a space ≈ 25 minutes by bike.
« Si, l'entretien, à peu près cent euros par an. Beaucoup moins, donc » — a hundred euros a year versus forty euros a month for parking.
« je vais essayer trois jours par semaine, pas tous les jours ». The bus is the plan for rainy days.
The price is in the graphics card, which a law student has no use for.

title: Comparing and choosing
